summary: <cite index="11-3,15-8">July CPI data released on August 12 showed headline inflation rose 0.1% month-over-month and held at 3.4% year-over-year, above the Fed's 2% target</cite>, while <cite index="10-2">the July jobs report showed the U.S. economy lost 23,000 jobs, dramatically missing expectations</cite>. <cite index="18-3,25-5">Wall Street rallied Thursday on cooler PPI data that reduced expectations for a September Fed rate hike</cite>, with <cite index="18-11,19-1">the S&P 500 closing at a record high around 7,800 for the first time</cite>. However, Friday brought caution as <cite index="20-6,24-6">the University of Michigan consumer sentiment index fell to 51 in August from 55.2 in July, and retail sales dropped for the first time in nine months</cite>. In crypto markets, <cite index="28-14">Bitcoin ETFs recorded a sharp $131.13 million net outflow on August 13, the largest daily pullback in weeks</cite>, though <cite index="28-20">Ethereum ETFs added $6.72 million in net inflows</cite>. <cite index="10-3,10-4">The combination of 3.4% headline inflation, negative job growth, and oil prices near $90 creates a challenging policy environment for the Fed</cite>.

signals.title: Consumer sentiment plunges to 51, retail sales drop for first time in nine months
signals.desc: August consumer confidence collapsed and July retail sales fell, raising concerns about economic weakness and sustainability of the S&P 500's rally past 7,800.

signals.title: July PPI cools more than expected, pushing Fed rate hike odds lower
signals.desc: Cooler-than-expected producer price inflation data reduced market expectations for a September Fed rate hike, fueling Thursday's record close.

signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs see $131 million outflow, largest pullback in weeks
signals.desc: Sharp institutional exit from Bitcoin ETFs on August 13 signals risk-off positioning despite BTC holding near $63,000.

signals.title: July jobs report shows 23,000 job losses versus 80,000+ expected gains
signals.desc: The weak employment print creates a Fed dilemma: sticky 3.4% inflation argues for tighter policy while labor weakness argues for pause.

signals.title: S&P 500 breaks 7,800 for first time on mega-cap tech strength
signals.desc: The benchmark hit its 27th all-time high of 2026 as AI optimism and falling rate hike odds lifted technology shares.

verdict: Markets face a tug-of-war between record equity highs and deteriorating consumer confidence as the Fed navigates stagflation risks with September policy decision in focus.
